results.title: Top Topics — sort modes (Frequency, Sentiment in polarity groups, A-Z)

steps.title: Given an authenticated user opens the category page with concepts
steps.expected: The Top Topics widget heading is visible (prefix Top Topics Associated with Your Brand) and the concept list is rendered

steps.title: When the user opens the Sort dropdown and applies Sort by Frequency
steps.expected: The dropdown closes and the trigger label updates to Sort by Frequency

steps.title: Then the concept list is ordered by frequency % in descending order
steps.expected: Each consecutive concept has a frequency % <= the previous one (e.g. 51, 44, 42, 31 …); the sources count is not the sort key and may be out of order

steps.title: When the user opens the sort menu
steps.expected: The menu lists "Sort by Frequency", "Sort by Sentiment" and "Sort A-Z", and no score entry

steps.title: And the user selects Sentiment
steps.expected: The list is re-ordered

steps.title: Then the Positive concepts come first, then the Mixed ones, then the Negative ones
steps.expected: Every "Positive" row is above every "Mixed" row, and every "Mixed" row is above every "Negative" row

steps.title: And no numeric score is exposed
steps.expected: No -100 to +100 value and no "{score} sentiment" text (e.g. "-80 sentiment", "+80 sentiment") is shown on the rows or in the sort menu

steps.title: When the user reads the frequency % inside the Positive group
steps.expected: The frequency % decreases from top to bottom (highest first)

steps.title: And the user reads the frequency % inside the Mixed and the Negative groups
steps.expected: In each group the frequency % decreases from top to bottom

steps.title: Then concepts with the same frequency are ordered by name A→Z
steps.expected: The concept whose name comes first alphabetically is listed first

steps.title: When the user applies Sort A-Z
steps.expected: The dropdown closes and the trigger label updates to Sort A-Z

steps.title: Then the concept list is sorted alphabetically by concept name
steps.expected: Concept names are in alphabetical order (case-insensitive ascending or descending)

results.notes: Data: Toyota › Voitures hybrides (439acd96 / 21a79173) — substitution for the old test data URL (not on staging). Sort menu: "Sort by Frequency", "Sort by Sentiment", "Sort A-Z" (no score entry). Frequency: 51,45,37,32,26,23,20,14,8,7,7,7,6,5,3,3,3 (descending). Sentiment: 14 Positive (51→3) then 2 Mixed (20,7) then 1 Negative (6); ties ordered A→Z ("leadership du marché" before "Problèmes récurrents" at 7%; "satisfaction client" < "simplicité d'utilisation" < "technologie auto-rechargeable" at 3%). No score text. A-Z: case-insensitive ascending. Sort restored to Frequency. Extra screenshot step4_az.
